entries.test: Public records of truck operations known to Marcus and documented cases of AI replacing radiologists as of October 2022 would establish whether either assertion had counterexamples outside the stated truck-pilot exception.
entries.note: Replacement refers to the radiologist's job, rather than assistance with individual tasks. The truck assertion is expressly limited to trucks Marcus knows of.

entries.test: Radiology job requirements and contemporary evaluations of convolutional networks on image interpretation, patient-history reasoning, and unstructured clinical text would test the claimed duties and relative suitability.
entries.note: The embedded tweet is Marcus's own statement, which he endorses in the surrounding discussion.

entries.test: Public evaluations of radiology AI across image interpretation, clinical-note reading, and other required duties would show whether success on selected tasks establishes competence across the entire job.
entries.note: This challenges an inference from partial capability to whole-job capability; it does not predict that full replacement will never happen.
